scripts.build: npm run check-shared && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Your own OpenRouter API key. Store as a secret; it is never accepted as client authentication.

SERVICE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Separate private service token. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32, then store it in your Worker secrets and trusted client secret store.

SERVICE_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of your deployment, with no trailing slash. Update after the first deployment and redeploy.
